name: Rub800 // Kafé Hærverk
description:
Rub800 spiller house, techno, breaks og elektro ++ fra 1990-2026.

Rub800 is an Oslo-based DJ and producer dedicated deeply to vinyl and machines. He is a familiar face at Oslo clubs, where he can be heard playing various moods of underground house, techno and beyond. He runs Continually (with Tonchius) and Airbrush records and has released on other labels such as Shadow Hide You, Phi, Mood Waves and Small Hours.

https://soundcloud.com/rub800
